grade_rationale: 8 P1 findings (threshold: C=max 2, D=any higher). Spec coverage ~15% (threshold: C=40%). Performance and chaos reports absent (static-only audit).

escalations.title: Handlebars.js — RCE via AST Type Confusion (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars@^4.7.10 in all workspaces
escalations.escalate_reason: Active RCE if handlebars processes untrusted input — exploitability must be confirmed by security team

escalations.title: proxy-addr — IP Spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 (CVSS 9.1)
escalations.fix: npm update proxy-addr@^2.0.8; verify Express trust proxy config
escalations.escalate_reason: IP spoofing bypasses access control; Express trust proxy config must be audited

escalations.title: protobufjs — Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.escalate_reason: Direct RCE risk in gRPC/protobuf services; attack surface must be confirmed

escalations.title: Tinypool — Prototype Pollution → RCE
escalations.escalate_reason: Prototype pollution enabling RCE in Vitest worker pool — exploitable if worker pool reachable

escalations.title: Vitest — Arbitrary File Read/Execute via UI Server (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.escalate_reason: Test infrastructure RCE; UI server on port 51204 may be accessible in CI environments

fixer_backlog.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md defines a product that does not exist (FR-001–FR-069: 0% coverage)
fixer_backlog.failure_scenario: Traceability enforcer run against this spec reports 76 missing requirements, permanently. No source file will ever satisfy these FRs because the codebase implements a different product.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Archive/annotate as aspirational or legacy. Add FR-WF-* IDs to Specifications/workflow-engine.md as the active canonical spec.

fixer_backlog.title: Traceability enforcer only checks Plans/ — Specifications/ never validated (false-green gate)
fixer_backlog.failure_scenario: npm run gates reports PASS while 89 Specification requirements are completely unimplemented. Developers receive a false signal of compliance.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan active Specifications/ documents. Add a specifications: list to inspector.config.yml for gate control.

fixer_backlog.title: Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md — all 10 FR-TMP-* requirements unimplemented
fixer_backlog.failure_scenario: FR-TMP-001 through FR-TMP-010 (risk classification, Playwright E2E, auto-PR, AI review, auto-merge, worker prerequisites) are absent from Source/. E2E files lack any // Verifies: FR-TMP-* comments.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Implement or formally de-scope. Add traceability comments to E2E files that partially satisfy these requirements.

fixer_backlog.title: FR-WF-001–013 defined only in Plans/ — inverts spec-as-source-of-truth rule
fixer_backlog.failure_scenario: All source // Verifies: comments trace to Plan-level IDs, not Specification-level IDs. If the plan file changes or is deleted, all traceability breaks with no Specifications/ anchor.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Add explicit FR-WF-001–FR-WF-013 requirements table to Specifications/workflow-engine.md.

fixer_backlog.title: Route handlers call store layer directly — 18 call-sites in workItems.ts, workflow.ts, intake.ts
fixer_backlog.failure_scenario: When in-memory store is replaced with SQLite (per FR-002), every route file must be rewritten. A service layer would have isolated the change to one file.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts. Route handlers call service; service calls store.

fixer_backlog.title: Jest ecosystem — HIGH CVEs across 17+ packages
fixer_backlog.failure_scenario: Test infrastructure with HIGH-severity CVEs; risk depends on whether jest runs in shared/hosted CI environments with untrusted test data.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Upgrade Jest to latest stable (30.x+). Run full test suite after upgrade. Coordinate with TheFixer for compatibility.

fixer_backlog.title: React & React-DOM one major version behind (18.3.1 → 19.3.1)
fixer_backlog.failure_scenario: Missing security patches and performance improvements in React 19; hook API breaking changes will accumulate the longer migration is deferred.
fixer_backlog.recommendation: Plan React 18→19 migration. Requires design review for breaking hook changes. Coordinate with TheFixer.
